title: claude-session config
description: Maps are deep-merged across config.yaml and config.d/*.yaml; lists are replaced, except hooks.* lists, which append. Environment overrides (CSESSION_<KEY>) apply only to these top-level scalar keys: claude_bin, default_kind, min_claude_version, summary_max_bytes, artifact_max_bytes, input_max_bytes, notes_context_timeout, notes_context_max_bytes, retention_days, lost_grace, auto_exit_delay, kill_grace, poll_interval, session_start_timeout (durations accept bare numbers of seconds).

claude_bin.description: Non-empty, no control characters (C0, DEL or C1).

min_claude_version.description: Minimum Claude Code version (claude --version) a launch accepts; older fails the launch with end_reason claude_too_old. Built-in: the version the spike verified.

default_kind.description: Kind used when --kind is omitted; must match the kind-name grammar.

permission_profile.description: Name of a permission profile from config.

implicit_done.description: Whether a clean headless exit without a report counts as done (report.implicit). false: exited-unreported with end_reason no_report. Built-in: false for gate-check and rank, true otherwise.

allow.description: Names or PREFIX_* globs. Only a kind's config env.allow naming a secret_env variable exactly passes it; per-call --env-allow cannot.

set.description: Literal non-secret values; ${CSESSION_DIR} ${CWD} ${HOME} ${GIT_DIR} expanded. Reserved CSESSION_* names are not allowed.

timeout.description: Seconds as a positive number (fractions allowed), or a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '90s', '10m', '0.5s'); zero is refused; at most 36500d (the text form too: the loader enforces the maximum, the string pattern does not). null or 'none': no bound.

interactive_timeout.description: Seconds as a positive number (fractions allowed), or a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '90s', '10m', '0.5s'); zero is refused; at most 36500d (the text form too: the loader enforces the maximum, the string pattern does not). null or 'none': no bound.

claude_args.description: Config files and drop-ins only; never from environment overrides or flags. Isolated runs accept only --verbose and --debug; anything else fails the launch (unsafe_claude_args). Trusted runs: anything.

kinds.description: Deep-merged over the built-in kinds (lists replace). A new kind starts from the built-in review kind's fields. Names: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$.

permissions.description: Claude Code permissions settings (allow, deny, ask, defaultMode, ...). additionalDirectories is refused for isolated runs, and defaultMode is ignored there (isolated runs always get dontAsk). Trusted runs: a profile defaultMode is used; without one the generated settings set default when setting_sources excludes user.

sandbox.description: Claude Code sandbox settings (network, filesystem). enabled, failIfUnavailable, allowUnsandboxedCommands, excludedCommands and autoAllowBashIfSandboxed: true are refused for third-party-reading or sandboxed runs (the generated autoAllowBashIfSandboxed is false); generated isolation keys always override profile content.

claude_auth_env.description: Added to the built-in list (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_MODEL, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX; AWS_* only with CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK; GOOGLE_*, CLOUD_ML_REGION, ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID only with CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX).

notes_context_timeout.description: Seconds as a positive number (fractions allowed), or a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '90s', '10m', '0.5s'); zero is refused; at most 36500d (the text form too: the loader enforces the maximum, the string pattern does not).

input_max_bytes.description: Cap for each --prompt-file and --input-file (bytes); larger exits 2.

lost_grace.description: Seconds as a positive number (fractions allowed), or a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '90s', '10m', '0.5s'); zero is refused; at most 36500d (the text form too: the loader enforces the maximum, the string pattern does not).

auto_exit_delay.description: Seconds as a non-negative number (fractions allowed), or a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '90s', '10m', '0.5s'); at most 36500d (the text form too: the loader enforces the maximum, the string pattern does not).

kill_grace.description: Seconds as a non-negative number (fractions allowed), or a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '90s', '10m', '0.5s'); at most 36500d (the text form too: the loader enforces the maximum, the string pattern does not).

poll_interval.description: Seconds as a positive number (fractions allowed), or a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '90s', '10m', '0.5s'); zero is refused; at most 36500d (the text form too: the loader enforces the maximum, the string pattern does not).

session_start_timeout.description: Seconds as a positive number (fractions allowed), or a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '90s', '10m', '0.5s'); zero is refused; at most 36500d (the text form too: the loader enforces the maximum, the string pattern does not). Headless runs: when no SessionStart arrives within it, exec logs a warning and adds it to warnings (injected hooks may be suppressed by disableAllHooks or managed-only hooks).

timeout.description: Seconds as a positive number (fractions allowed), or a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '90s', '10m', '0.5s'); zero is refused; at most 36500d (the text form too: the loader enforces the maximum, the string pattern does not). Default 30s. On timeout the hook's process group gets SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after kill_grace. Gate hooks need an explicit longer timeout.

labels.description: Run only when the session has all these labels (AND).

repos.description: Keyed by repo id: lowercase host, optional :port only for a non-default port, then /-separated path segments [A-Za-z0-9._-]+.
